label: The Cox proportional hazards model: the hazard at time t for a patient with covariate x is an unknown baseline hazard times an exponential risk multiplier
The hazard ratio: the constant multiplier on the baseline hazard comparing x plus one unit to x
Cox partial likelihood: over the observed event times, the exponential score of the patient who failed divided by the sum over that time's risk set
Back-of-envelope standard error of the log hazard ratio: two divided by the square root of the number of events
Required events for 80 percent power at a two-sided 5 percent level: four times the sum of the two z quantiles, squared, divided by the squared log of the assumed hazard ratio
